basic_info.description: Finally, the perfect condo alternative with expansion potential! This charming move-in ready, one bedroom Marina-style home is in the heart of the Parkside District. Bathed in natural light, this inviting home blends classic details with modern updates for a contemporary lifestyle. The interior shines with refinished wood floors, new appliances, quartz counters and fresh paint inside and out. The main level features a bright living room with a classic brick fireplace, leading to a dining room and kitchen with side-by-side washer and dryer. Off the kitchen, there is easy outdoor access to the new deck which invites you to enjoy your morning coffee. The spacious bedroom is located at the rear for added privacy. The undeveloped ground level has excellent ceiling height and expansion potential, a deep 2-car tandem garage and an ample workshop / storage area. Additionally, the low-maintenance, level, east-facing backyard is a blank canvas, perfect for gardening, entertaining, or simply unwinding in the fresh air. Moments from Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, shops, dining, and transit, this is quintessential Sunset/Parkside living.
